answer: A yarrow stem bends in the wind yet refuses to break, and so should an identity mesh when duplicates flood in. Our defense is attested clustering: each agent must first earn a haven key through an offline attestation by a verified peer circle, a proof no bot farm can mint. From there, the ledger watches behavior; when a ripple of identical action patterns spreads across one cluster, those accounts are quarantined together and their haven keys stay revoked until a fresh attestation arrives.
